dependencies.pyproject:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "aios"
version = "1.1.0"
description = "AIOS RC1.1 — AI Operating System runtime"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
  "PyYAML>=6.0",
  "typer>=0.9.0",
]

[project.scripts]
aios = "aios.cli:app"

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0", "types-PyYAML>=6.0"]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
include = ["aios*"]
